children: Artivion’s third-quarter revenue increased 9% year over year, while it swung to a net loss from net income. Growth in aortic stent grafts and On-X products drove revenue higher; higher costs and an unfavorable product and tissue mix weighed on gross margin, while increased operating expenses also pressured results.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
